extension.name: Digitest Debug
extension.author: F.Galuppi - Digitest.net
extension.description:
Digitest Debug Plugin - My Debug and Environment Controller
Do not forget to set your UserID (or IDs) in the PlugIn parameters


Actual version 3.1.2 - J6.

field.name: myUserIds
field.label: User/s ID(s)
field.description: Users ID who have to see Debug lines. More IDs comma separated

field.name: ModPosCounter
field.label: Module Pos. to Count
field.description: Write here Template Position if you have to count how many Modules are on a this position

field.name: textColor
field.label: Text Color
field.description: Change the color of text for a better contrast with background color of your template

field.name: check_missing_assets
field.label: Missing Assets
field.description: Enable Console Analysis in the Web Tools for any missing files or wrong paths
